description: Machine-readable smoke test catalog for rekit maintainers. This file is a navigation aid, not an automatic test runner.
globalBoundaries: Use temporary cases unless a script explicitly supports a known dryrun case.
Do not point smoke tests at real case data.
Do not execute samples, network requests, scans, fuzzing, exploit replay, debug, dump, patch, hooks, device connections, or external side effects.
Do not write authority or confirmed artifacts outside scripts that explicitly validate a temporary-case gate.

tests.purpose: Validate PowerShell facade default delegation and fallback boundaries, including overview/note JSON readonly, note append/what-if, gate what-if/apply, and start/handoff JSON preview/apply delegation.
tests.riskBoundary: Default fixture is self-contained; explicit CaseRoot must be a known dryrun case.

tests.purpose: Validate packs/status/doctor/validate text and JSON parity across Go, PowerShell, and facade delegation.
tests.riskBoundary: Read-only except transient invalid pack fixtures that are created and removed inside packs/.

tests.purpose: Validate catalog.json schema, unique ids, script/doc paths, field completeness, all script coverage, and pack smoke discovery alignment.
tests.riskBoundary: Read-only catalog and filesystem consistency check; does not run case smoke scripts except pack matrix discovery.

tests.purpose: Validate pack smoke matrix discovery, JSON envelope, deduplication, text output, and unknown pack guard.
tests.riskBoundary: Runs a small self-contained pack smoke subset under WorkRoot; no real case data.

tests.purpose: Compare schema-valid skeleton packs from inventory with matrix entries and pack smoke wrappers.
tests.riskBoundary: Read-only inventory and filesystem consistency check; does not run pack smoke wrappers.

tests.purpose: Run all or selected skeleton pack smoke wrappers serially, with text or JSON output.
tests.riskBoundary: Runs self-contained temporary case smoke only; does not auto-discover unknown scripts.

tests.purpose: Shared helper used by skeleton pack smoke wrappers; not intended to be run directly.
